text:
Cascend Securities Boosts Apple (AAPL) Price Target to $220.00 Posted by Alanna Baker | Feb 22nd, 2018 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its target price hoisted by Cascend Securities from $200.00 to $220.00 in a research report report published on Monday, January 29th, MarketBeat reports. Cascend Securities currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
AAPL has been the subject of a number of other reports. Rosenblatt Securities reissued a hold rating and issued a $150.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Sunday, October 15th. Citigroup reaffirmed a buy rating and issued a $200.00 target price (up from $170.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, November 3rd. They noted that the move was a valuation call. UBS Group set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a report on Monday, December 4th. Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating and set a $197.00 price target on the stock in a research note on Thursday, January 18th. Finally, Pacific Crest upgraded shares of Apple from a sector weight rating to an overweight rating and set a $187.00 price target on the stock in a research note on Monday, October 16th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has an average rating of Buy and a consensus target price of $201.64. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) traded up $1.43 during trading hours on Monday, hitting $172.50. 30,690,976 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 42,870,000. The firm has a market capitalization of $875,270.00, a P/E ratio of 16.88, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $135.28 and a fifty-two week high of $180.10. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.46%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 24.66%. 
In other Apple news, insider Johny Srouji sold 10,368 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, November 24th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.68, for a total transaction of $1,811,082.24. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $14,246,900.80. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this link . Also, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, December 7th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total transaction of $2,654,121.29. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,942,594.29. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders sold 107,011 shares of company stock worth $18,414,885. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders. 
Institutional investors and hedge funds have recently made changes to their positions in the company. ADAMCAPITAL Gestao de Recursos Ltda. acquired a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter worth approximately $127,691,000. Chemical Bank now owns 92,548 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $15,662,000 after purchasing an additional 299 shares during the period. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. now owns 942,286 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $159,463,000 after purchasing an additional 13,995 shares during the period. PHH Investments Ltd. now owns 10,218 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,729,000 after purchasing an additional 572 shares during the period. Finally, Certified Advisory Corp acquired a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter worth approximately $3,158,000. 59.70% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
